claim: The AWS database decision guide says to use Amazon Aurora DSQL when the application needs distributed SQL with active-active multi-Region replication, strong consistency, and no servers to manage.
question: When does the AWS database decision guide point to Aurora DSQL instead of an Aurora cluster?

values.display: distributed SQL with active-active multi-Region replication
values.spoken: distributed SQL with active-active multi-Region replication

qualifiers.scope: Aurora DSQL in the AWS database decision guide
qualifiers.condition: out of scope for the exam; mention only to rule it out

note: d27-121, d27-113. DSQL is a separate service, not an Aurora cluster feature; it is not in the in-scope service list of the exam guide.
